title: FDIST and TINV: W109 moved their worst-case residuals and never published a count
status_plain: Both surfaces were improved by W109 and neither received a numerator. FDIST's b22 content is a worst-case ULP movement from +37 to -15; TINV's is a residual band moving from -4..-238 to mostly +-1..7. Neither is a count and neither can be made into one. The only fractions either surface has ever received are pre-W109 rows of the W097 R-D histogram, recorded separately.
evidence_locality_note: Every W109 battery (b14, b19, b20, b21, b22, b26, b30, b31) lives under `smart-fuzzer/work/` or `smart-fuzzer/cache/`, both gitignored in OxFunc.
substrate: BRATIO (TOMS 708) with accurate-complement wrapper stagings; TINV roots the two-tail surface
open_question: Neither surface has a post-W109 pass count. The improvements are real and unquantified as fractions.
reader_warning: A worst-ULP movement is not a pass rate and a residual band is not a fraction. This record publishes no count for either surface.
citations: content/evidence/harvest/RV-distributions.md — the primary-source re-derivation this record follows
schema_additions: counts[].source_sentence — the verbatim source sentence carrying the figure (mandated: every figure must be traceable to a quoted sentence).
counts[].figure_display_only — const true; makes FOUNDATION §2.5's 'figure is display only, guard G-9' explicit on the datum itself.

counts[].builds / build_ambiguity / arch / cpu / cpu_scoped / excel_bitness / workbook_mode / plumbing — FOUNDATION puts these in a record-level `oracle` object. They are carried PER COUNT here so that no count can inherit an environment from a sibling count in the same record.

counts[].currency — enum current | current-and-only | superseded | pre-repair-baseline | stale-in-source | withdrawn. Answers ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS §2.3 item 2: a superseded figure must be dispositioned 'superseded', not silently absent.
counts[].ambiguity_note — nullable; the published statement of an unresolved source ambiguity attached to this specific figure.

counts[].measurement_subject gains the value 'handbook-recomputation-over-cached-corpus' — a computation over stored bits performed by an agent, NOT a live-Excel oracle run. Required by the re-measurement rule; such counts always carry handbook_reverified:false and may never be shelved beside an oracle run.
counts[].build_ambiguity gains the value 'not-stated-in-this-record' for sources that name no Excel build anywhere.

upstream_anchor.cited_text_sha256_basis — 'git-object-at-473efa3' or 'working-tree-untracked-path' (smart-fuzzer/work, smart-fuzzer/cache and .tmp are gitignored in OxFunc, so no object exists at the commit).
upstream_anchor.cited_lines — the line range the sha256 was computed over.

counts[].build_note — nullable; where in the document a build IS named, when it is not named on the scored line. builds[] itself stays EMPTY in that case, because a build may never be inherited from elsewhere in the document.
